Class AnnotationScalars

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.util.AnnotationScalars
@Internal public final class AnnotationScalars extends Object
Narrows a literal from the Python processor (a String, Boolean, Integer, Long or Double) to the declared scalar annotation member type, the way the Java annotation processor would deliver it. Python is more permissive than Java here: value=True on a String member becomes "true", and 1 on a long member becomes 1L.
Since:
5.2.0
